page.overview:
Who is Scimitarta?

Scimitarta is a member of the Endurance Curry Pirates.

Scimitarta is a man with curly dark hair covered by a turban with his crew's Jolly Roger drawn on the front. He wears a striped vest and baggy pants, along with a jewel necklace and bracelets ob his right wrist and upper arm.

Scimitarta is a good-natured speedfreak, who particularly enjoys racing across the ocean on his flying flag. He is excited at the prospect of finding the One Piece.

Scimitarta possesses a magical flying pirate flag.
